insights.one_liner: Mid-sized Amsterdam bank owned by Turkey's Garanti and ultimately BBVA; currently posting English-language internships in compliance and finance.

culture.text: About 326 staff in Amsterdam since 1990, doing trade finance, corporate and retail banking in the Netherlands and Germany.
Strong Turkish link: top schools of staff include Boğaziçi, Marmara, Middle East Technical and Istanbul University, alongside University of Amsterdam.
Its internship programme covers transaction monitoring, sanctions screening and anti-money laundering in an international banking setting.

open.text: All 5 jobs here are Amsterdam internships open to non-Dutch speakers, drawing about 80 LinkedIn applicants on average.
Not found as an IND recognised sponsor.

worth_knowing.text: Wholly owned by Türkiye Garanti Bankası, ultimately part of BBVA, and supervised by the ECB, DNB and AFM.
